Card Q&A.a: It triggers at the timing when this card is in the trash and your [Dorugoramon] would be deleted. [Trash] means that an effect can trigger and activate when the card is in the trash.
Card Q&A.q: When exactly is the timing when this card's [Trash] [All Turns] effect triggers?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. However, the DP-reducing effect will be carried over after the [Dorugoramon] effect activates and digivolution occurs, therefore deletion will occur again if the DP is still 0 after the effect activates and digivolution occurs.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [Trash] effect to digivolve when my [Dorugoramon] would be deleted by its DP becoming 0, can I prevent that deletion?

Effect: [Trash] [All Turns] When one of your [Dorugoramon] would be deleted, by digivolving it into this card without paying the cost, prevent that deletion.

[When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 3＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if [Dorugoramon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or this digivolved from the trash, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another Digimon is deleted, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
